title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: When considering the dimensions of a matrix, remember that the number of columns in the original matrix $X$ will determine the number of columns in $V**{T}$. How many columns does $X$ have?

title: PCA Decomposition Insight
text: In PCA, the matrix $V**{T}$ is derived from the right singular vectors of $X$. These vectors correspond to the features of $X$. How many features does $X$ have?

title: Counting Columns in $X$
text: How many columns are there in the matrix $X$?
